data: Which value of T corresponds to the green line on the right side of the figure?

The green line on the right side of the figure corresponds to the value of T = 0.1. This can be determined by observing the color coding in both graphs. In the left graph, the green line represents the value of T = 0.1. In the right graph, the green line also corresponds to the same value of T = 0.1. Therefore, the value of T corresponding to the green line on the right side of the figure is 0.1.
